verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents AuthKit as a spec-compatible OAuth authorization server with built-in OAuth applications for web, mobile, desktop and CLI clients. Its official SDKs ship PKCE public-client helpers (Rust, iOS, Astro, TanStack Start, Node client-ID-only mode) and automatic token refresh and session management (React, Astro), so developers avoid hand-rolling the protocol, and the Device Authorization Flow is also supported. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the PKCE and refresh-token flows work as documented.
